title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Find the largest Hausdorff dimension of points that stay bounded forward in time but escape backward in area-preserving planar flows or discrete systems, and determine its dependence on differentiability.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200010 (AMR-051-0010). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Alexander Plakhov, Problem 1, p. 8.
